name: craft-skills
description: Vendor-neutral research and engineering skills for Codex: craft-mode, principle owners, situational workflows, and domain tools discovered from skills/*/SKILL.md.

interface.shortDescription: Craft-mode, principle owners, and research and engineering workflows
interface.longDescription: craft-skills discovers its packages from skills/*/SKILL.md. Invoke craft-mode for multi-step playbooks, principle-architecture, principle-backend, principle-frontend, principle-programming, or principle-testing for policy, and named workflows for explanation, correction, TDD, evidence, review, parallel work, recall, and prose editing. Domain packages cover APIs, databases, CI/CD, design, documentation, research, debugging, version control, structural search, project bootstrap, ML, GPUs, security, browsers, Obsidian, Orca, and Tailscale.
defaultPrompt: Use craft-skills craft-mode for a verified multi-step engineering task
Use craft-skills principle-backend for service architecture and persistence
Use craft-skills document to structure project docs
Use craft-skills research to investigate before deciding
